text:
maria_cs: Heads-up — ACME (mid-market trial) goes live tomorrow. Need a concise customer-facing checklist we can paste into kickoff: cache TTL guidance, client batching best-practices, streaming fallback strategy, quick renewal-risk signals, and a tiny feedback capture template. cc @sam_cs @vin_devex

sam_cs: +1. We should keep it super actionable. single-pager with 6 bullets max. :memo:

vin_devex: Draft suggestions: 1) Tenant-scoped prefix cache keys (user_id:prompt_hash). 2) Default TTL 10m for generated completions, shorter 60s for ephemeral session state. 3) Stale-while-revalidate: serve cached and refresh async for <200ms UX.

alex_sre: Also add infra knobs: 1) max inflight per-tenant = 8, 2) burst queue = small token budget, 3) enable warm pools during first 72h. For batching: prefer 4-6 requests/batch for low-latency apps; larger batches for throughput-only flows.

jordan_eng: Streaming fallback: recommend SSE/HTTP2 streaming by default for chat UX. If streaming error or >500ms queue, fall back to short-polling with incremental tokens. Example snippet for client:```js
// request with streaming, fallback to polling
const res = await fetch('/api/generate?stream=1');
if (!res.ok) pollUntilDone();
```

sam_cs: Renewal-risk signals to surface to AE/CS: 1) sustained latency >1s p95 on customer routes, 2) monthly usage drop >40% vs baseline, 3) repeated quality regressions on eval prompt set, 4) canceled warm pools or frequent quota hits. For each signal, include immediate action: warm-pool enablement, model rollback, targeted health call.

lucy_pm: Feedback capture template (tiny): "1) What were you trying to achieve? 2) Did the result meet your needs? (yes/partly/no) 3) Any examples/short copy?" Add survey link + quick slack snippet to paste to user. Keep it 3 Q max so CS gets responses. :point_up:

metrics-bot: Quick metric query (example):```sql
SELECT customer_id, pct_change(monthly_tokens) as drop FROM usage WHERE customer_id='acme' AND pct_change(monthly_tokens) < -0.4;```

vin_devex: Ops note: recommend shipping a tiny client-side SDK snippet customers can paste to enable batching + streaming toggles. Provide defaults and a one-line toggle: `window.RW_BATCH_SIZE = 6` etc.

maria_cs: This is gold. I'll assemble the one-pager. Can folks do a super-fast pass on wording? I want a customer-facing paragraph and the 6 bullet checklist. Need it by EOD.

alex_sre: Quick pass done — wording ok for customer-facing. Suggested tweak: avoid internal terms like "warm pools" in user doc; phrase as "pre-warmed capacity". :thumbsup:

sam_cs: I'll add the renewal signal table and action map.

jordan_eng: I'll attach the client snippet and streaming fallback example into the doc.

lucy_pm: I'll craft the 3-question feedback card and short Slack paste.

maria_cs: Thanks everyone — I'll publish to the shared CS templates folder and paste into the kickoff convo. If anyone objects to outward phrasing, flag now.

alex_sre: No objections. Go for it. :rocket:
